title: Linear header
description: A 72px near-black bar that stays on top for the whole page, 80% opaque with a backdrop blur and a white-8% hairline under it: a wordmark at the left, small grey nav links that light up with a faint pill on hover, a thin divider, a 'log in' link and a pale pill 'sign up'. On phones: log in, sign up and a two-bar menu button that opens the links in a full-height panel.
notes: sticky: put it at the top level of the page so it stays for the whole scroll
content lines up with the 1280px frame of the other linear blocks
name: linear-header

props.name: brand
